entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, material_key, context_role(original_input|structural_dependency|related_input), source_related_reference_id NULL, final_product_material_key, disposition_kind(carried_forward|replaced_and_settled), mount_scope_id, inode, size_bytes, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, endpoint_id, location, binding_revision, binding_evidence_digest, admitted_control_revision NULL, admitted_control_projection_digest NULL, derived_authority_digest NULL, settlement_expectation(retain|replace_or_move|remove_after_place), context_member_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,material_key,context_role)`；Primary/structural variant要求Control pair并禁止Related fields；related variant要求source reference/derived authority且Control pair为NULL。每个Run Basis Related必须恰有一row并映射到同Package Product member：carried要求source/final materialKey相同且`replace_or_move`，replaced要求不同且`remove_after_place`；按materialKey/contextRole排序并进入offload及Related disposition set digest，不构成Arca动作选择或删除授权

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, offer_id, on_deck_package_id FK, package_digest, arca_acceptance_decision_id, arca_acceptance_decision_digest, result(accepted|rejected), handoff_receipt_id, handoff_receipt_digest, custody_id NULL, arca_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, closure_digest NULL, received_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `receipt_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-delivery-receipt-id@1",offerId}))`，offer逐字节等于Package row且`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；accepted要求Custody/Binding/Control列非NULL、rejection/closure列NULL，并逐项无损保存`ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1` Receipt；rejected要求Custody/Binding/Control列NULL且decision/receipt/rejection/closure digest逐项等于`ArcaProductRejectedMessage@1`与`LibraProductRejectionClosureResult@1`；terminal后immutable，相反终态稳定拒绝；`INDEX(result,received_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_id PK, name, target_endpoint_id, target_root_location, target_mount_scope_id, target_mount_scope_revision, status, current_standard_revision, current_placement_revision, routing_projection_revision, routing_projection_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: mount scope pair是Platform opaque technical ref；active Shelf name不作为identity；Shelf创建时routing projection revision=1，任何后续`status/current_standard_revision`变化都对该revision执行CAS并加1，再按`ShelfRoutingTargetProjection@1`公式重算digest；`INDEX(status,shelf_id)`；不得保存Libra Routing Priority

entries.columnsContract: `rule_template_id PK, name, owner_kind(system|user), status(active|archived), current_revision, created_at_ms, archived_at_ms`
`rule_template_id FK, revision, rules_schema_ref, rules_json, rules_digest, published_at_ms`
`rule_template_id PK/FK, draft_revision, base_published_revision, rules_schema_ref, rules_json, rules_digest, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 只允许user template；一个Template最多一份current draft；发布以expected draft revision/digest消费但保留审计Evidence

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_id FK, revision, rule_template_id, rule_template_revision, standard_schema_ref, standard_json, standard_digest, effective_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: Standard JSON上限`64 KiB`；`PK(shelf_id,revision)`；Shelf current pointer显式FK；当前row中的template pair同时是Shelf current Template binding权威来源；`INDEX(rule_template_id,rule_template_revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_id FK, revision, policy_schema_ref, policy_json, policy_digest, effective_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: Policy JSON上限`16 KiB`；`PK(shelf_id,revision)`；Shelf current pointer显式FK

entries.columnsContract: `acceptance_attempt_id PK, offer_id, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, shelf_id FK, standard_revision, placement_revision, state(active|accepted|rejected), created_at_ms, finished_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: 同一Offer至多一个Attempt且相同`package_digest+standard+placement`至多一个active attempt；Related disposition set必须逐字节等于Package；accepted/rejected只允许从active以Decision事务CAS一次；Supporting Work通过Foundation反向关联；`INDEX(state,created_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `offer_id PK, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, acceptance_attempt_id NULL, active_work_id, work_kind, failure_phase NULL, error_code NULL, terminal_attempt_count, owner_domain, recovery_state(active|attention_required|automatic_recovering|user_retrying|resolved), recovery_generation, automatic_recovery_used, recovery_trigger_digest, failed_trigger_digest NULL, incident_key NULL, updated_at_ms, resolved_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: 一份Offer恰有一个current Recovery Case；`recovery_generation`从1单调递增且每个generation派生不同Supporting Work ID，历史Work/Event/Attempt不修改；技术失败只允许`active|automatic_recovering|user_retrying → attention_required`，不得建立Acceptance Decision；trigger变化最多一次`attention_required → automatic_recovering`，用户Retry一次只创建一个`user_retrying` generation；Accepted/Rejected后才`resolved`；`INDEX(recovery_state,updated_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `acceptance_attempt_id FK, check_kind, check_revision, result, evidence_digest, completed_at_ms`

`acceptance_decision_id PK, acceptance_attempt_id FK, result(accepted|rejected), offer_id, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, shelf_id FK, standard_revision, placement_revision, acceptance_evidence_set_digest, rejection_schema_ref NULL, rejection_code NULL, rejection_digest NULL, decision_digest, decided_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `acceptance_decision_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"arca.acceptance-decision-id@1",acceptanceAttemptId}))`且`UNIQUE(acceptance_attempt_id)`；Offer/Package/Related disposition set逐字节等于Attempt；accepted要求rejection列全NULL且证明完整处置义务可履行；rejected固定`rejection_schema_ref=StructuredRejection@1`且code/digest非NULL，并逐项重建`ArcaAcceptanceRejectionDecision@1`；immutable

entries.columnsContract: `custody_id PK, acceptance_decision_id FK, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, control_scope_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, state, accepted_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,package_digest)`；只有Accepted Decision可建立；`control_scope_digest`只覆盖正式Product Control transfer，`related_disposition_set_digest`逐字节冻结Package中全部exclusive Related的source-to-final义务，两者不得合并为一个Control Scope
